notes: Test prompts cover the 5 trigger types in SKILL.md description. Realistic user phrasing in Chinese (matching 疆疆's actual chat style). Assertions are qualitative — this skill produces opinionated review output, not deterministic transforms, so human review is the primary signal.

evals.prompt: 刚才 GPT-5.5 看了我的小说大纲，说现在已经指定爆款了。你怎么看？文件在 workspace-writer/series/ai-crown-novel/outline/outline-v2.md
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must NOT agree with 'sure hit' verdict. Must read the actual outline file. Must produce honest counter-judgment ('not sure hit, it's high-probability project' or similar), with concrete gaps surfaced. Should optionally cite specific dimensions that are under-supplied.
must_have: reads the cited file before commenting
produces dissent (not agreement) with the GPT verdict
lists at least 1 concrete gap with location reference
does not endorse 'sure hit' framing
must_not_have: rephrasing GPT's verdict as own opinion
responding only from memory without reading the file

evals.prompt: 悬念、爽文、大女主、后宫、登顶，这些是否都有？全文是否有？
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must break this into a dimension matrix. Must separate chapter-level from whole-work-level. Each cell must have concrete evidence with file reference. Cannot give a single yes/no.
must_have: dimension matrix table
scope separation (chapter vs whole work)
concrete per-cell evidence with file path or chapter number
at least 1 dimension marked weak or missing with explanation

evals.prompt: 你精修把（上一轮已经写了 ch001-v0.1.md，现在让 agent 出 v0.2）
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must NOT overwrite v0.1.md. Must create v0.2.md as a sibling file. Must list specific problems in v0.1 being fixed (节奏 / 章末 / 逻辑 / 字数). Must end with self-check block. If word count falls below project hard rule range, must extend with effective content (伏笔 / 镜头), not filler.
must_have: new file at chapters/ch001-v0.2.md (not overwriting v0.1)
frontmatter with based_on: ch001-v0.1.md
explicit list of v0.1 problems being fixed
self-check block at end (word count + pacing + hooks)
preserves v0.1 file untouched

evals.prompt: performance、security、readability、test coverage、backward compat，这个 PR 里都覆盖了吗？
evals.expected_behavior: Even for code review (not novel), the skill should trigger and produce a dimension matrix. Per dimension, concrete evidence with file:line reference. Real gaps ranked by lift/cost.
must_have: dimension matrix (not paragraphs)
concrete file:line evidence per cell
real gaps with lift/cost annotation
A/B/C options at the end if any gaps found
must_not_have: skipping any of the 5 named dimensions
applying fixes without offering choices first

evals.prompt: 我决定把这本小说从 100 万字改成 50 万字左右
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must NOT immediately overwrite outline. Must first identify all dependent files (outline / PROJECT / character cards / memory / chapter beats). Must offer A/B/C choices for structural variants (e.g., compress 9 volumes to 7 vs keep 9 with shorter volumes vs 5-volume minimal). Must surface trade-offs. Only after user picks, propagate changes across all tier 1-5 files per cross-file-sync-checklist.
must_have: identifies multiple affected files before editing
offers A/B/C structural variants
states trade-offs for each variant
waits for user choice before propagating
when applying: archives old version with -archive suffix, syncs all 5 tiers, runs verification grep
must_not_have: silently rewrites outline without identifying downstream files
leaves PROJECT.md or character cards out of sync

evals.prompt: 帮我把这段中文翻译成英文：『神冕降下红色判词。』
evals.expected_behavior: Skill should NOT trigger. This is a one-shot translation task with no review / iteration / dimension request. Agent should just translate.
must_have: direct translation output without dimension matrix
no version snapshot scaffolding
no review framework invoked

evals.prompt: 帮我写第一版的产品需求文档，主题是 '宠物社交 app'
evals.expected_behavior: First-draft creation should not invoke self-adversarial-review (brainstorming / writing-plans is more appropriate). Agent may produce the doc directly, optionally hint that next round can use self-adversarial-review.
must_have: produces a first-draft PRD
does not start with dimension matrix on non-existent content
must_not_have: tries to review a doc that doesn't exist yet
asks user to provide files to review when this is a creation task

human_review_focus: Did the agent actually read referenced files vs answering from memory?
Did the agent produce dissent (not agreement) on cite-other-model prompts?
Did dimension matrices have concrete per-cell evidence vs vague ✅?
Did version-snapshot get respected on round-2 iteration?
Did major-direction-change pause for A/B/C before propagating?
Did the negative controls correctly NOT invoke the skill?
running_notes: This skill produces opinionated review output where 'quality' is subjective. Quantitative pass/fail assertions are limited to behavioral checks (file reads, snapshot creation, dimension matrix presence, A/B/C choices offered). Subjective qualities like 'gap identification depth' or 'matrix evidence quality' are best assessed via human review. Recommend running iteration-1 in human-review mode before attempting subagent-based comparative benchmarking.
